# ”Tufft att vara blankare”

**Feed**: kort-och-lang  
**Published**: 2026-05-04  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Dagens Industri's analysis desk reviews a Q1 reporting season that has been solid overall, despite large currency headwinds and muted share-price reactions, while the Strait of Hormuz crisis has not triggered a crash, which makes life hard for short sellers. The featured cases are Assa Abloy as a stable compounder, subscribing to the Silex IPO, selling Camurus, and a possible buying opportunity in Norion when Balder distributes its stake. The hosts then preview the week's reports: Verisure, Hoist, Cloetta, Novo Nordisk, Skanska, Millicom, Balder and others. The macro tone is cautious and could weigh more once the reporting season ends.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ASSA-B — Assa Abloy | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Stock of the week by colleague Magnus Dager: stable compounder, rising dividends, digital-lock megatrend.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst (Magnus Dager, DI): steady growth, strong cash conversion and rising cash flow with modest capex allow ever-higher dividends. Digital locks are sticky and carry higher margins, bolt-on M&A lifts acquired margins, and it is well placed versus peers. The hosts agree.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth stalls
- if margins erode from acquisitions
- if owner strategy changes unfavourably

> *"Det här är ett stadigt växande bolag som inte gör så himla mycket väsen av sig, men som är väldigt stabilt och bra nu för tiden."*

---

### 🔴 CAMX — Camurus | **SELL** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Mikael Olsson switches from buy to sell; growth targets likely missed, short interest rising.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst (Mikael Olsson, DI) changes from buy to sell. Interesting technology and tariff resilience are not enough: the company is expected to miss its growth targets, short sellers are adding positions, and there are better alternatives. A host is reconsidering her positive view.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth targets are reaffirmed or beaten
- if short interest unwinds on strong data

> *"Däremot tycker han att det är dags att sälja Camurus."*

---

### 🟢 NORION — Norion | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Balder's distribution of its 48% stake may create an overhang; P/E below 8 and buybacks make forced selling a buying opportunity.

#### Reasoning

Host view: Balder is distributing its roughly 48% stake, so institutions that don't want a niche bank may sell and cause volatility. The valuation is low (P/E below 8), with a SEK 500m buyback and about SEK 800m excess capital. Free float rises from about 20-28% to 60%, boosting interest. Accumulate on weakness.

#### Sell Triggers

- if credit losses rise materially
- if the buyback is withdrawn
- if valuation re-rates without a dip

> *"Så gillar man den här aktien, värderingen låg när de handlas under 8 gånger årets förväntade vinst. Och kommer det då ut aktier till salu så kan man nog göra lite spännande fiske där tror jag."*

---

### 🟠 VSURE — Verisure | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Under pressure after a -16% reaction to the last report and trading 20% below its IPO price; poor communication and thin consensus. Don't trade on the first print.

#### Reasoning

Hosts are critical: the stock fell 16% on its last report and sits 20% below the IPO price, reports only in EUR, and consensus is thin (3 of 12 analysts). They advise not trading instantly on Wednesday's numbers but waiting until the market digests them. Another weak report would be tough.

#### Sell Triggers

- if another weak report
- if subscriber growth slows

> *"Hela den här tiraden gynnar ut i att man kanske inte ska trycka på knappen jättesnabbt siffrorna kommer in"*

---

### 🟡 BRAV — Bravida | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host's autumn stock of the week has done well; margins expected to keep improving.

#### Reasoning

Host Anna recommended Bravida last autumn and it has performed well so far. She expects continued margin expansion and will watch order intake and large-project commentary in the Q1 report.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margins decline
- if order intake weakens

> *"jag har en sån här veckans aktie på dem. skrev här i höstas, och den har gått bra så här långt."*

---

### 🟡 CLA-B — Cloetta | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Julia Forsberg closed her buy call after an exceptional run because the valuation has stretched.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst (Julia Forsberg, DI) closed a successful buy call because the valuation has run away. Operations have improved after scrapping the Dutch factory, but the upside looks priced in.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the valuation stretches further without earnings support

> *"Vår kollega Julia Forsberg hade ett mycket bra köpråd på den aktien som hon faktiskt stängde, för den värderingen har dragit iväg."*

---

### ⛔ KINV-B — Kinnevik | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Hosts question Kinnevik's USP; it is stuck in unlisted growth holdings and a strategy review is needed.

#### Reasoning

Hosts say Kinnevik lost its way chasing unlisted growth companies at the peak and now struggles to exit. They have 'somewhat given up' and cannot name its USP. A strategy review is likely coming and could change the view.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a credible new strategy is announced
- if successful exits materialise

> *"Lite har man gett upp för att det känns som någon själva faktiskt har gått vilse lite"*

---
